Translate one R-side window_spec() into the plain list gpu_window() (src/ops_window.cpp) expects

Source: R/lower.R
build_window_cpp_spec.Rd

default_value/default_valid collapse window_spec()'s default field (an IR literal node, or NULL) into the shape build_scalar() (src/expr_eval.hpp) already accepts elsewhere: no default supplied, and an explicit default = NA (spec$default$na), both mean the same thing for lag()/lead() (an invalid/NA fill scalar of the value column's own type) – so both collapse to default_valid = FALSE, default_value = NULL.

Usage

build_window_cpp_spec(spec, out_pos, schema)

Arguments

spec

A window_spec() structure

out_pos

0-based position of this spec among the whole ast_window node's appended columns

schema

The node input's schema (list(names=, types=))

Value

A plain list: list(fn, value_idx, out_type, out_pos, n, default_value, default_valid, na_rm), plus roll_path (the internal cuplyr.roll_path switch, see ?roll) for a rolling spec
